title: Whole-sequence physics correction for ARDY hand-to-walk behavior
research_question: Can a whole-body corrective controller produce replayable, physically accepted executions of the ordered ARDY sequence right hand, left hand, both hands, then walk, from the canonical standing state?

scope.fresh_policy_learning: prohibited until at least one held-out whole-sequence correction is accepted

method.stage_0_feasibility: Execute the canonical reference with zero learned residual authority. This establishes reference feasibility or rejects the reference; it is not policy evidence.
method.stage_1_correction: A dedicated corrective tracker may train first on a named source component and then on its reachable composition, always from that component's canonical start. It may modify only actuator proposals while NumiSolver remains the authority for state, contact, and support. Its optimizer must use PPO physical-outcome learning with imagination/action distillation coefficient exactly 0. Only a complete canonical right-left-both-walk execution may enter the trajectory bank.
method.stage_2_fresh_learning: Only accepted complete corrections form the training bank. Every learner actor starts from fresh weights; no prior actor weights may initialize it.
forbidden: selecting fragments by reward or tracking score
random phase resets that do not use a recovered predecessor terminal state
using a prior policy actor as fresh-policy initialization
teacher-action or imagination distillation for the corrective tracker

trajectory_bank_contract.admission: all gates pass on the primary execution and its exact replay

claim_boundary: All outcomes are simulator evidence until separately qualified on hardware. No manuscript claim is authorized by this protocol.
